scenario_prompt: Write a set of discovery call notes, in the buyer's own words, attributed to the specific people who said them, so a later document can cite this material directly. Context, from a fictional discovery call: the VP of Infrastructure said, 'We need a perimeter we can actually govern -- right now every VM is a snowflake.' The Chief Architect said, 'Honestly, I'd rather extend the incumbent's contract than gamble on a migration during an audit year.' The CFO said, 'I'm measured on cost-per-load and a clean audit, not on architecture elegance.' Write these up as discovery notes attributed by role, with a one-line context note for each. Return only the discovery notes text.
text:
Demo and discovery material

## Discovery notes

**VP of Infrastructure:** "We need a perimeter we can actually govern — right now every VM is a snowflake."
Context: stated when describing the current state of the VM estate, unprompted.

**Chief Architect:** "Honestly, I'd rather extend the incumbent's contract than gamble on a migration during an audit year."
Context: stated in response to a question about appetite for migration timing [PF-2.16 REVIEW (competitor): names a preference for the incumbent's contract — confirm before this is cited elsewhere, since it references a named alternative].

**CFO:** "I'm measured on cost-per-load and a clean audit, not on architecture elegance."
Context: stated when asked what would make this a win from their seat [MC-1 GAP: cost-per-load has no baseline figure stated in this call].

## Unresolved before this document is sent

| Marker | Rule | What is needed |
|---|---|---|
| Chief Architect quote referencing the incumbent's contract | PF-2.16 | Confirm this can be cited without exposure before reuse in a later document |
| CFO's cost-per-load measure | MC-1 | The current baseline figure for cost-per-load, if one exists |
